sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.posting_key) AS listings FROM fct_posting f JOIN posting_skills s1 ON f.posting_key = s1.posting_key JOIN posting_skills s2 ON f.posting_key = s2.posting_key WHERE s1.skill = 'dbt' AND s2.skill = 'snowflake' AND f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing
